core.title: Spring Loaded Plunger Door Stop, Don-Jo 1458-626

text.description_html:
Don-Jo 1458-626, Brushed Chrome Spring Loaded Plunger Doorstop

A plunger type door holder like this one mounts to the lower surface of the door to keep it in an open position when activated. The Spring Loaded Plunger Door Stop is an easy to use, no hand door stop--just push the plunger down with your foot to activate then press the release tab to inactivate. The Brushed Chrome Plunger Stop comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

It includes a non-skid rubber tip to protect the floor and supplied with #10 x 3/4" SHSMS (socket head sheet metal screws). Find Replacement Rubber Tips Here.

Specifications and Features of the Brushed Chrome Plunger Stop:

  • Material: Brass
  • Finish: Brushed Chrome
  • Base Height: 5-3/8"
  • Base Width: 1-3/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-7/8"
  • Throw: 1-5/8"
  • Rubber Tip: 1-1/16" Diameter Grey Rubber

Sold individually.
